channel.title: Cyber Threat Wall — New KEVs
channel.description: Vulnerabilities newly appearing in CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.

item.title: CVE-2026-136716 — Drupal Core
item.description: Threat Signal 69. Drupal Core contains an improper check for unusual or exceptional conditions vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to take over a site via the exposed Drupal installer when the site is in one of the affected unusual or incomplete installation states.

item.title: CVE-2026-120705 — OSGeo GeoServer
item.description: Threat Signal 49. OsGeo GeoServer contains an XML injection vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to cause the server to read local text files accessible to the GeoServer process or fetch attacker-specified HTTP or HTTPS URLs via a crafted ID parameter in the WFS 2.0 GetFeatureById stored query. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-129244, CVE-2026-129243, CVE-2026-129245, and CVE-2026-129242 to achieve unauthenticated remote code execution on an affected GeoServer instance.

item.title: CVE-2026-129243 — OSGeo GeoServer
item.description: Threat Signal 49. GeoServer contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to bypass service-level role checks and invoke operations protected solely by those checks via a request with a prefixed service parameter. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-129244, CVE-2026-120705, CVE-2026-129245, and CVE-2026-129242 to achieve unauthenticated remote code execution on an affected GeoServer instance.
